english.notes: (i) Regulation 38(2A) was added on 7th April 2019; from that date, it is not an offence for a person to fail to comply with the environmental permit conditions in Part 3 of Schedule 9 (waste operations: management and technical competence conditions).

other.penalty:
Either Way -

Summary: maximum 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Note:
In relation to an offence committed before paragraph 24(2) of Schedule 22 to the Sentencing Act 2020 comes into force (01/12/20), the reference to 12 months imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
Time limit for prosecutions:
None
